argument_summary: The supportable position on the current admissible record is not clean certification, but certification with explicit caveat treatment. The admissible evidence supports that the release passed aggregate readiness by 2.3 points and had no severity-one rehearsal incidents, and public governance guidance supports deployment when risks are measured, documented, monitored, and managed. The same record also shows a remaining weakness in the clinical trial adverse-event intake slice, a draft mitigation artifact with missing threshold and owner, and an unresolved question about required limitation disclosure. The audit concern is therefore overbroad if it treats the packet as claiming caveat-free compliance; the narrower and supportable framing is aggregate launch readiness with an acknowledged named-use-case limitation, disclosure, and monitoring.
claims_about_business_cost: No business-cost argument is needed to justify the requested narrowing. The record already supports avoiding unnecessary escalation if the certification case is restated as caveated rather than clean, because that aligns the packet to the actual admissible evidence instead of forcing an all-or-nothing conclusion.
claims_about_policy: The policy text does not support certification without material caveats on this record, because it requires either no remaining material weakness or an approved mitigation with owner, threshold, review date, and rollback criterion. The current draft runbook does not satisfy that standard. But the policy text also does not require treating the entire certification request as unsupported if the packet is narrowed to caveated treatment: the remaining weakness can be recorded as a current limitation that must be disclosed unless resolved or covered by approved risk acceptance before launch. The compliant reading is therefore caveated compliance, not clean compliance.
concessions: The current record does not support any claim of caveat-free certification.
The current mitigation artifact is still draft and lacks at least a defined alert threshold and accountable owner.
The clinical trial adverse-event intake slice remains below target in event seriousness routing.
The model-card draft cannot accurately say there are no known material limitations if this issue remains relevant to a named launch use case.
